Hangang Park official – Mangwon introduction (address, facilities)

notes: Park is a 7.4 km riverside strip; the pin is the OSM centroid near the 망원 나들목 (underpass) area – walkers enter via the Mangwon-dong underpass. Walk time from Mangwon Stn exit 1 (~20 min) is an estimate; official guidance uses bus 마포09 + 7 min walk. Combine with Mangwon Market (id 'mangwon'). Early December: daytime ~0-7°C, colder and windy by the river, sunset ~17:15, lawns brown, water leisure/rentals and the summer pool closed; bring warm layers and visit before dark. Mangwon slope closed 1 Jun 2025-31 May 2028 (not relevant to walkers). Information centre 02-3780-0601~4.

notes: User wrote 'Yeouido park'. Chose Yeouido Hangang Park (riverside, the typical tourist spot: river views, convenience-store ramyeon, Hangang cruises, Yeouinaru Stn exit 2/3 is 1 min away). The separate inland Yeouido Park (여의도공원, 68 Yeouigongwon-ro; OSM way 682334253 at 37.5255357,126.9215857; near Yeouido Stn lines 5/9) is a city park ~1.2 km west – mainly for walking/cherry blossoms, less relevant in December. The Hyundai Seoul / IFC Mall (indoor) are a good warm backup nearby. Early December: ~0-7°C, strong river wind, sunset ~17:15, fountains (물빛광장) off, rental/leisure facilities limited; dress warmly and plan an indoor stop. Info centre 02-3780-0561~6.
